item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 23/Mar/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Winds will be weak and the weather will be generally fine over the coast of southern China tomorrow. The temperature difference between day and night will be rather large. A southerly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong midweek this week. It will be humid with relatively low visibility in some areas. It will be hot during the day. The northeast monsoon is expected to reach southern China in the latter part of this week. The weather will become cool and windy with a few showers over the region. There may be thunderstorms over inland areas. Under the influence of the monsoon, it will remain cool in the morning over Guangdong early next week.
